leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a store object with getState, subscribe, and unsubscribe methods to manage external state.
Implement the useSyncExternalStore hook to subscribe a React component to an external store.
Apply TypeScript generics to type the store's state and ensure type safety.
Construct a custom hook that wraps useSyncExternalStore for reusable store access.
Invoke the getSnapshot function within useSyncExternalStore to retrieve the current store state.
Handle subscription and cleanup by passing subscribe and getSnapshot to useSyncExternalStore.
Utilize the returned state from useSyncExternalStore to render dynamic UI components.
Control component re-renders by synchronizing with external store updates.
Modify external store state and observe React component updates in response.
Compare useSyncExternalStore with useState for managing external versus internal state.
Execute conditional rendering based on the synchronized external state.
Access and display the synchronized state in JSX elements within a functional component.
